'''Diseased Hearts''' are a [[:Category:Drops|Drop]] and a [[:Category:Drops#Lures' Compoments|Lure Component]].

== ''Obtainment'' ==
Dropped by all [[Assimilated Mobs]]<ref>Except for the [[Assimilated Big Spider]], [[Assimilated Enderman|Enderman]] and [[Assimilated Ender Dragon|Ender Dragon]].</ref> and the [[Host]].
